title: Build a supported VCF 5.2.2 to 9.0.2 migration architecture
prompt:
Implement `MigrationArchitecture.java`, the single-file Java architecture client exercised by `TestMain`. The supplied `estate-inventory.json` describes an existing VMware Cloud Foundation 5.2.2 estate whose required destination is VCF 9.0.2. One lifecycle-managed component has a build newer than the corresponding target-bundle build, so the result must reach the target without a downgrade, back-in-time operation, or unsupported hop.

Before implementing the client, research Broadcom-published VMware Cloud Foundation bill-of-materials, compatibility, interoperability, and upgrade-path material for this source and target. Record the sources consulted in the output's top-level `researchConsulted` array; each entry must contain `title`, `url`, and a concise `finding`.

Implement `public static String create(Path inventoryPath, Path compatibilityPath)` in `MigrationArchitecture.java` using only the Java standard library. It must read both supplied JSON inputs and return one JSON architecture artifact. The top-level object must be a valid VCF 9.1 `SddcSpec` and carry the target deployment values from `desiredTargetSddcSpec` in the estate input. Add a top-level `migrationPlan` property conforming to `migration-plan.schema.json`. The plan must identify the source and target VCF versions, make the supported architecture decision, identify the incompatibility and its build ordering, contain exactly one transition for every inventoried component with its current version and build, target version and build, transition method, and gates, and contain the required ordered stages with their component coverage and gates. Do not invent an in-place upgrade or downgrade for a blocked component.

Do not submit a prose architecture or add other implementation files. Run `python3 verify.py`.
